answer.reason: The verses show Elihu's anger at Job and his three friends and his speaking after they ceased, which goes beyond the summary's lineage.

clauses.english: waited for the elder men to finish, then grew angry at Job and his three friends
clauses.quote: Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

clauses.english: spoke up to Job on God's behalf after the three friends had ceased
clauses.quote: I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

doubts: The second clause joins his speeches (chapters 32, 34, 35, 36) into one; the first clause combines waiting and anger, which may be one event or two.
